This Rmd runs functions for the outputs of application results in Lim et al.

```{r setup}
library(PopGenBounds)
library(patchwork)

dir_output <- "C:/Users/limy/OneDrive - International Agency for Research on Cancer/Documents/NoahCollab/code/output"
```


## Load genotype data and allele frequencies
```{r}
toad_genotypes <- PopGenBounds::toad_genotypes
Toad_microsat_freq = PopGenBounds::Toad_microsat_freq

# fix allele order for each locus
lv   <- microsat_allele_levels(toad_genotypes)
```

## Run (or load) bootstrap on global population (K = 47)

```{r run global bootstrap}
set.seed(2021)
res <- boot_stat(toad_genotypes, stat_fun = Diff, B = 1000, type="percentile")
res$mean             # check the labels in the 'statistic' column
```
```{r save bootstrap output}
saveRDS(res, file.path(dir_output, "global_bootstrap_B1000.rds"))
```

```{r load saved bootstrap object}
boot_res_global <- readRDS(file.path(dir_output, "global_bootstrap_B1000.rds"))
names(boot_res_global)
```
## Plot statistics distributions for global comparison

```{r, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 3}
get <- function(s) sapply(res$estimate, function(d) d$value[d$statistic == s])

ggtoad <- ggbounds_raw(M = get("M"), FST = get("FST"), GpST = get("G'ST"), D = get("D"),
                       K = 47, ci = res$mean, density_colors = FALSE, ci_style="bands")

ggtoad[[1]] + ggtoad[[2]] + ggtoad[[3]]
```
## Caterpillar plot for global bootstrap
```{r, fig.width = 8, fig.height = 2.8}
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

caterpillar_loci <- function(res, stat, y_label, ylim = NULL) {
  f <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(res$estimate), function(l) {
    d <- res$estimate[[l]]
    cbind(locus = l, d[d$statistic == stat, c("value", "value_lower", "value_upper")])
  }))
  f$locus <- factor(f$locus, levels = f$locus[order(f$value)])     # rank by value
  m <- res$mean[res$mean$statistic == stat, ]                       # mean over loci

  ggplot(f, aes(x = locus, y = value, ymin = value_lower, ymax = value_upper)) +
    #annotate("rect", xmin = -Inf, xmax = Inf, ymin = m$value_lower, ymax = m$value_upper,
    #         fill = "red", alpha = 0.15) +
    #geom_hline(yintercept = m$value, colour = "red", linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 0.4) +
    geom_linerange(colour = "grey60", linewidth = 0.8) +
    geom_point(size = 1.5) +
    labs(x = paste("Loci (ranked by", stat, ")"), y = y_label) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1)) +
    coord_cartesian(ylim = ylim)
}

res <- boot_res_global
p_fst  <- caterpillar_loci(res, "FST",  expression(italic(F[ST])),       ylim = c(0, 1))
p_gpst <- caterpillar_loci(res, "G'ST", expression(italic(G*minute[ST])), ylim = c(0, 1))
p_d    <- caterpillar_loci(res, "D",    expression(italic(D)),            ylim = c(0, 1))

p_fst + p_gpst + p_d
```


## Run (or load) pairwise bootstrap (K = 2)

```{r}
set.seed(2021)
res_pw <- boot_pairwise(toad_genotypes, B = 1000)
```

```{r save boot output}
saveRDS(res_pw, file.path(dir_output, "pairwise_bootstrap_B1000_monomorph_excluded.rds"))
```


```{r check mono exclusion}
pts <- do.call(rbind, res_pw$estimate)
get <- function(s) pts$value[pts$statistic == s]

sum(!is.na(get("FST")))                                             # 9622, as in the old code
all.equal(sort(get("FST")), sort(toad.tib_pairs$FST))               # TRUE (sort drops NA)
all.equal(mean(get("FST"), na.rm = TRUE),
          res_pw$overall$value[res_pw$overall$statistic == "FST"])  # TRUE: red dot
```


```{r load saved bootstrap object}
res_pw <- readRDS(file.path(dir_output, "pairwise_bootstrap_B1000_monomorph_excluded.rds"))
names(res_pw)
```
```{r check the number of stats on monoorphic loci (M=1)}
pts <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(res_pw$estimate), function(l)
  cbind(locus = l, res_pw$estimate[[l]])))
mono <- pts[pts$statistic == "M" & pts$value >= 1, ]
table(mono$locus)            # number of monomorphic pairs per locus
```

## Plot bootstrap catterpilar plots
```{r, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 2.5}
caterpillar <- function(tab, stat, y_label) {
  f <- tab[tab$statistic == stat, ]
  f <- f[order(f$value), ]
  f$rank <- seq_len(nrow(f))
  ggplot(f, aes(x = rank, y = value, ymin = value_lower, ymax = value_upper)) +
    geom_linerange(colour = "grey60") +
    geom_point(size = 0.4) +
    labs(x = paste("Population pairs (ranked by", stat, ")"), y = y_label) +
    theme_bw()
}

p_fst  <- caterpillar(res_pw$mean, "FST",  expression(italic(F[ST])))
p_gpst <- caterpillar(res_pw$mean, "G'ST", expression(italic(G*minute[ST])))
p_d    <- caterpillar(res_pw$mean, "D",    expression(italic(D)))

p_fst + p_gpst + p_d
```
## Report bootstrap intervals in a table

```{r, csv table}
m <- res_pw$mean[, c("pop1", "pop2", "statistic", "value", "value_lower", "value_upper")]
supp <- reshape(m, idvar = c("pop1", "pop2"), timevar = "statistic", direction = "wide")
names(supp)   # pop1, pop2, value.M, value_lower.M, value_upper.M, value.FST, ...
#write.csv(supp, file.path(dir_output, "toad_pairwise_bootstrap_mean_loci.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```
```{r heatmap}
library(ggplot2)
f <- res_pw$mean[res_pw$mean$statistic == "FST", ]
pops <- levels(toad_genotypes$pop)

hm <- rbind(data.frame(x = f$pop1, y = f$pop2, fill = f$value,                 what = "FST"),
            data.frame(x = f$pop2, y = f$pop1, fill = f$value_upper - f$value_lower, what = "CI width"))
hm$x <- factor(hm$x, levels = pops); hm$y <- factor(hm$y, levels = pops)

ggplot(hm, aes(x, y, fill = fill)) +
  geom_tile() +
  facet_wrap(~ what) +
  scale_fill_viridis_c() +
  coord_fixed() +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, size = 5), axis.text.y = element_text(size = 5),
        axis.title = element_blank())
```

### Summary of bootstrap CI
```{r summary of bootstrap CI pairwise}
pw <- res_pw$mean
stats <- c("M", "FST", "G'ST", "D")

pair_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(stats, function(s) {
  f <- pw[pw$statistic == s, ]
  w <- f$value_upper - f$value_lower
  data.frame(statistic      = s,
             value_min            = min(f$value, na.rm = TRUE),
             value_median         = median(f$value, na.rm = TRUE),
             value_max            = max(f$value, na.rm = TRUE),
             median_ci_width = median(w, na.rm = TRUE),
             mean_ci_width   = mean(w, na.rm = TRUE),
             max_ci_width    = max(w, na.rm = TRUE),
             median_bias     = median(f$value_bias, na.rm = TRUE))
}))

print(pair_summary, digits = 3)
```
```{r summary of bootstrap CI global}
res <- boot_res_global
gl <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(res$estimate), function(l)
  cbind(locus = l, res$estimate[[l]])))
stats <- c("M", "FST", "G'ST", "D")

locus_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(stats, function(s) {
  f <- gl[gl$statistic == s, ]
  w <- f$value_upper - f$value_lower
  data.frame(statistic       = s,
             value_min       = min(f$value, na.rm = TRUE),
             value_median    = median(f$value, na.rm = TRUE),
             value_max       = max(f$value, na.rm = TRUE),
             median_ci_width = median(w, na.rm = TRUE),
             mean_ci_width   = mean(w, na.rm = TRUE),
             max_ci_width    = max(w, na.rm = TRUE),
             median_bias     = median(f$value_bias, na.rm = TRUE))
}))

print(locus_summary, digits = 3)
```

# Plot SEM (standard error of the mean) for global comparisons

```{r}
get_g <- function(s) sapply(res$estimate, function(d) d$value[d$statistic == s])  #returns vector of stat values in loci

# the standard error of mean: sd(values across loci)/sqrt(n_loci)
sem <- function(x) { x <- x[!is.na(x)]; sd(x) / sqrt(length(x)) }

sapply(c("M", "FST", "G'ST", "D"), function(s) sem(get_g(s)))
```
```{r plot SEM, fig.width = 7, fig.height = 2.4}
sem_tab <- do.call(rbind, lapply(stats, function(s) {
  x <- get_g(s); m <- mean(x, na.rm = TRUE); e <- sem(x)
  data.frame(statistic = s, value = m, value_lower = m - e, value_upper = m + e, sem = e)
}))
sem_tab

sem_tab$value_lower[sem_tab$statistic == "M"] <- sem_tab$value[sem_tab$statistic == "M"]
sem_tab$value_upper[sem_tab$statistic == "M"] <- sem_tab$value[sem_tab$statistic == "M"]

gg <- ggbounds_raw(M = get_g("M"), FST = get_g("FST"), GpST = get_g("G'ST"), D = get_g("D"),
                   K = 47, ci = sem_tab, ci_style = "bands", mean_style = "bound",
                   ci_color = "blue", ci_linewidth = 0.8, ci_alpha=0.08, density_colors = F)


gg[[1]] + gg[[2]] + gg[[3]]

sem_tab[, c("statistic", "sem")]
```

## SEM computed from mean stats over loci of pairwise means. 
```{r fig.width = 7, fig.height = 2.4}
stats <- c("M", "FST", "G'ST", "D")

se_cluster <- function(f) {
  f   <- f[!is.na(f$value), ]
  n_l <- tapply(f$value, f$locus, length)       # points per locus
  m_l <- tapply(f$value, f$locus, mean)         # locus means
  w   <- n_l / sum(n_l)                         # weights
  m   <- sum(w * m_l)                           # mean over all points (the red dot)
  L   <- length(m_l)
  sqrt(L / (L - 1) * sum(w^2 * (m_l - m)^2))    # SEM for weighted sum of loci means
}

se_tab_pw <- do.call(rbind, lapply(stats, function(s) {
  f <- pts[pts$statistic == s, ]
  m <- mean(f$value, na.rm = TRUE)              # mean over all points
  e <- se_cluster(f)
  data.frame(statistic = s, value = m, value_lower = m - e, value_upper = m + e, se = e)
}))

# no bar for M
is_m <- se_tab_pw$statistic == "M"
se_tab_pw$value_lower[is_m] <- se_tab_pw$value_upper[is_m] <- se_tab_pw$value[is_m]
se_tab_pw


gg_pw <- ggbounds_raw(M = get("M"), FST = get("FST"),
                      GpST = get("G'ST"), D = get("D"),
                      K = 2, ci = se_tab_pw, ci_style = "cross", mean_style = "bound",
                      relative_density = FALSE, density_limits = c(0, 5000),
                      ci_color="black", ci_linewidth=0.8, ci_alpha=0.1)
gg_pw[[1]] + gg_pw[[2]] + gg_pw[[3]]
```
```{r}
setNames(se_tab_pw$se, se_tab_pw$statistic)
```

```{r if SEM were computed from loci with equal weight}
pts <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(res_pw$estimate), function(l)
  cbind(locus = l, res_pw$estimate[[l]])))
get_pw <- function(s) pts[pts$statistic == s & !is.na(pts$value), ]   # values of one statistic, with locus
lm_pw <- function(s) tapply(get_pw(s)$value, get_pw(s)$locus, mean)   # 10 pairwise locus means
sapply(stats, function(s) sem(lm_pw(s)))                               # equal-weight pairwise SEM
```



# Other

## Plot individual loci
```{r, , fig.width = 7, fig.height = 2.7}
plot_locus <- function(l) {
  d <- res_pw$estimate[[l]]
  g <- function(s) d$value[d$statistic == s]
  p <- ggbounds_raw(M = g("M"), FST = g("FST"), GpST = g("G'ST"), D = g("D"), K = 2,
                    relative_density = FALSE, density_limits = c(0, 600))
  p[[1]] <- p[[1]] + ggtitle(l)
  p[[1]] + p[[2]] + p[[3]]
}

plot_locus("F22")                                         # one locus
plot_locus("1A")                                         # one locus
```
